basic_info.description: Beautiful 2 unit building in Cow Hollow with outdoor space off both units, 2+ car garage and views! LOWER UNIT (One Level): 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, open kitchen, spacious living/dining area, deck in the rear with garden access, yard.         UPPER UNIT (2 Levels): FIRST LEVEL: 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, open kitchen, spacious living/dining area,  deck in the rear with garden access, yard. UPPER LEVEL: Finished attic with beautiful Golden Gate Bridge/water views (currently used as a large bedroom.) Large garage (2 car + tandem parking), 2 sets of washer/dryers in garage and abundant storage. Situated on a 30-ft wide lot in a non-liquefaction zone.
